title: Run of the increment carry phase
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and suppose its transition at label $c_B$ is the increment-carry action on register $r$, continuing at $c_B$ when the scanned symbol is present and otherwise proceeding to the next label. Suppose also that $c_B$ is not an oracle-call label. For any configuration $c$, word $w$, natural number $n$, and integer $p$ with $p+1=n$ and $p<|w|$, starting with the head at $p$ on a tape containing $w$ reaches after $n+1$ steps the same tape with the head at $0$ and state `next`. At every earlier time $t<n+1$, the configuration has state $c_B$, the same tape, and some head position $q$ with $-1\le q\le p$.
